subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 339 (PCC-23). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), LK-IMP (linkage implications) and TR-INFO (trans-information). From T-C-IMP: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From LK-IMP: INFO-DS (information dissemination). From TR-INFO: RE-ST (restructuralism). From COS-P: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From INFO-DS: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From VT-DY: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
